notes:
A widely used verb covering two main domains: making information public (announcements, publications, releases) and giving oral presentations in academic or business settings. The noun form ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧ is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}{発表|はっぴょう}→研究発表：24674_kenkyuuhappyou⟧: research presentation
- ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: press conference
- ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}{会|かい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧: presentation event; recital
- ⟦{新|しん}{製品|せいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発表|はっぴょう}する: announce a new product
- ⟦{声明|せいめい}→声明：03763_seimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発表|はっぴょう}する: issue a statement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公表|こうひょう}する→公表する：21375_kouhyou⟧: to make public; to disclose — emphasizes revealing information that was previously undisclosed, often official data or statistics
- ⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to send out; to communicate — focuses on transmitting information or messages, especially in media or online contexts
- ⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧: to report — involves reporting findings or progress to a specific audience, typically superiors or stakeholders
